name: Modiin-Maccabim-Reut
registryCustodian: Modiin-Maccabim-Reut Municipality, Engineering / municipal GIS (advertised local service); Israel Mapping Center publishes the queried parcel layer
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Hebrew discovery found the official municipal GIS description and the first-party Israel Mapping Center parcel FeatureServer. Layer metadata was inspected anonymously. A bounded envelope query in EPSG:2039, converted to WGS84 output, returned three Polygon features with native parcel identities 9856, 9857, and 9858 and locality Modiin-Maccabim-Reut. Govmap and the municipal page were blocked by 403 on direct fetch; neither failure was treated as absence.
scopeLimits: The three-feature response is a bounded map-extent sample, not a citywide extract.
The WUP point [31.8986246886273,35.0077621307069] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
A map-extent hit does not prove every municipal parcel is exposed or current.
The direct municipal GIS endpoint was not resolved, and the national layer does not by itself prove local service ownership.
No login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
sourceSpecificFields: The layer schema exposes PARCEL_ID, GUSH_NUM, GUSH_SUFFI, PARCEL, GushHelka, locality fields, status fields, and geometry. Only stable parcel identity and geometry were considered for retention; no raw source attribute set is retained.
compositeKeyProvenance: Returned features expose PARCEL_ID as the preferred stable native identity; GUSH_NUM plus PARCEL and the GushHelka string were requested only as bounded qualification evidence and cross-checks.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; serial reviewer must independently verify URL stability, CRS handling, field mapping, citywide coverage expectations, and safe identifier choice.
uncertainty: Full unchanged query response is retained only in ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/modiin/query.geojson. No sample GeoJSON was retained, so no source-specific properties are exposed in cohort artifacts.
